mfa.setupBody: Admin access needs a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator…) every time you sign in.
mfa.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.verifyBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for IntroChat.

notAdmin.title: No admin access
notAdmin.body: {{email}} is not an IntroChat admin. Ask an existing admin to give you access.

home.venuesNext: Venue and table management arrives in the next update.

venues.title: Venues
venues.empty: No venues yet. Create the first one.

venue.name: Name
venue.slugHelp: Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens. Part of every QR link of this venue.
venue.slugLocked: Fixed: it is inside every printed QR card of this venue.

problems.slugFormat: Use 3–40 lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or end.

pin.title: Location pin
pin.noResults: No places found. Try a shorter search, or drag the pin.
pin.dragHint: Drag the pin or tap the map to move it.
pin.fromPhoneHelp: At the venue: stand in the middle of the seating area and keep the phone still.
pin.fromPhone: Set pin from my phone here (30 s)
pin.fromPhoneDone_one: Pin set from {{count}} precise reading (best ±{{accuracy}} m). Check it on the map, then save.
pin.fromPhoneDone_other: Pin set from {{count}} precise readings (best ±{{accuracy}} m). Check it on the map, then save.
pin.fromPhoneImprecise: No precise reading here (best ±{{accuracy}} m). Location may be weak at this venue: try near a window, and note it.
pin.outsideIndia: The pin must be in India. Check that it is on the right place.
pin.notPlaced: Place the pin on the venue: search its address, tap the map, or set it from your phone there.
pin.locatedPrecise: Pin placed at this device's location (±{{accuracy}} m). Check it on the map and drag it if needed.
pin.locatedRough: This device's location is rough (±{{accuracy}} m), so the pin may be off. Drag it to the exact spot, or set it from a phone at the venue.

test.title: On-site test
test.help: Walk around with this phone: to each table, the door and outside. You see live what a guest standing here would get.

states.inside: INSIDE: a guest here can join
states.outside: OUTSIDE: a guest here is refused
states.unknown: UNKNOWN: location not precise enough here

test.numbers: {{distance}} m from pin · accuracy ±{{accuracy}} m · radius {{radius}} m · max accuracy {{maxAccuracy}} m

status.title: Status
status.activeHelp: Active: guests can scan this venue's QR codes.
status.inactiveHelp: Inactive: QR codes show "not active". Add tables and check the pin, then activate.

tables.title: Tables and QR cards
tables.invalidRange: Enter a range of 1 to {{max}} tables.
tables.label: Table name
tables.regenerateConfirm: Make a new QR for {{label}}? Its printed card stops working immediately and must be replaced.

urlWarning.local: These cards point to {{url}}, which guests' phones cannot open. Use them only for testing.
urlWarning.temporary: These cards point to the temporary address {{url}}. Reprint them after the final domain is set up.

payments.title: Payments
payments.refundHelp: Refund in the Razorpay dashboard first, then record it here.
payments.subscriptionRefundHelp: The scans this subscription bought that are still unused are removed.

globalSettings.title: Settings
globalSettings.help: Defaults for every venue. A venue can override some of them on its own page. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
globalSettings.locked: changes only with an app update

reports.title: Reports
reports.evidenceErased: The evidence was erased after its retention period.
reports.noChat: They never chatted: reported from the people list.
reports.kickHelp: Ends their visit at this venue (if any) and keeps them out of it for 12 hours.
reports.banHelp: Ends their visit and keeps their account, phone and device out of every venue.

tags.title: Tags and blocked words
tags.blockedWordsHelp: New interests containing one of these words are refused. Block a tag already in use above.

close.title: Close for today
close.help: Ends every visit here and refuses scans until midnight (venue time).
close.confirmHelp: Everyone here is logged out. Paid visits are listed afterwards so you can refund them.
close.noPaid: No paid visits were cut short.
close.refundHint: Refund paid entries in Razorpay and record them in Payments; give subscribers their scan back in Guests.

flags.title: Location flags
flags.help: Visits whose location looked faked, last 7 days. A weak GPS can trip these too: judge before acting.
flags.atStart: At entry: {{distance}} m from the pin, accuracy ±{{accuracy}} m

stats.title: Stats
stats.noMessages: Messages are not counted: chats are deleted when visits end.

sms.title: SMS usage
sms.empty: No login codes in the last 7 days.

admins.title: Admins
admins.deactivateHelp: They lose access to the Console at once.
admins.reactivateHelp: They can sign in to the Console again.
admins.addHelp: First create their login in the Supabase dashboard (Authentication → Users → Add user), then add their email here. They set up 2-step verification at first sign-in.

password.title: Change my password
password.help_other: At least {{count}} characters. Use a password manager.

deletions.title: Account deletions
deletions.help_one: Delete within {{count}} day of the request.
deletions.help_other: Delete within {{count}} days of the request. Payments, reports about them and bans stay.
deletions.openReports_one: {{count}} open report about them: review it first.
deletions.openReports_other: {{count}} open reports about them: review them first.
deletions.banned: Currently banned. The ban stays after deletion.
deletions.confirmHelp: Their profile, chats, visits and scans are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
